title: 鼠疫通常可治：俄方却封院查200人，为何反应远超鼠疫？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Dr. Dahlja, I did not think we would be talking about something that feels potentially, could be very serious so soon after COVID. What do we need to know here?
segments.zh: Dahlja医生，没想到新冠疫情刚过，我们又要讨论可能非常严重的事情。我们需要了解什么？

segments.en: What we need to know is, well, there's a two different question to say, but what we do know is a 28-year-old who works at the anti-plague institute in Siberia,
segments.zh: 我们需要知道的是，这有两个不同的问题，但我们已知的是，一名28岁在西伯利亚抗鼠疫研究所工作的人，

segments.en: died of pneumonia of unknown epidemiology, meaning unknown cause. They didn't know what caused to her pneumonia. And she supposedly was vaccinated against everything she worked with,
segments.zh: 死于不明原因的肺炎，即病因未知。他们不知道是什么导致她患上肺炎。据称她接种了所有工作相关疫苗，

segments.en: that this wasn't plague, but what we saw was the Russian government basically act very proactively, very aggressively, quarantining the hospital she was treated in,
segments.zh: 认为这不是鼠疫，但我们看到俄罗斯政府基本上非常积极、非常强硬地行动，隔离了她接受治疗的医院，

segments.en: as mass suits, monitoring 200 contacts. And that is incongruous with plague. People might think of plague and think that's the worst thing it could be. That's not the worst thing it could be.
segments.zh: 穿着防护服，监测200名接触者。这与鼠疫不符。人们可能认为鼠疫是最糟糕的情况。但事实并非如此。

segments.en: Plague, in general, is treatable. There are protocols when people are exposed. It doesn't usually merit the type of response we saw in Russia. So that raised a lot of alarm bells that this was
segments.zh: 鼠疫通常可治疗。有暴露后的处理方案。通常不需要俄罗斯那种应对措施。因此这敲响了警钟，

segments.en: something novel, something you, that they were worried about, that they were trying to contain, that it might have been spreading from person to person. That's what we wanted to know
segments.zh: 可能是新型病原体，他们担心并试图控制，可能已人传人。这就是我们想知道的，

segments.en: about. Those are the questions that are still outstanding, and that's what Russia needs to really be transparent about. So Dr. Dahlja, how concerned, I mean, should we be right now? I mean,
segments.zh: 这些问题仍未解决，俄罗斯需要真正透明。那么Dahlja医生，我们现在应该有多担心？

segments.en: with everything that you've been saying so far, what should we know? How concerned should we be?
segments.zh: 根据你目前所说的一切，我们应该知道什么？应该有多担心？
